chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Never playing piano again and remembering song lyrics
summary: He never played piano professionally again, could only accompany his own singing, and forgets lyrics over time.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Listening to classical music, then and now

blocks.x: Have you ever played piano professionally since?
No, no, I didn't. No. After that I wouldn't dare. I wouldn't dare. I would sound like a beginner. But if I was singing, I could just halfway accompany myself, you know.
Did you know a lot of songs then already?
Oh yeah. I've known songs from way back.
You knew the whole...the lyrics and everything?

I used to. You know, in time you do forget various ...(?)... Like you forget people. You meet so many people... And lyrics are the same way. You know, you see new lyrics, and if you're a singer, you have to learn them, and you can't just remember that many. You might know them well when you're doing them, but you come back two or three years or four years behind that, and you try to sing them, you forget the lyrics.
